**Calculating Color Placement**

I'm currently focused on determining the correct color placement within the grid, given its dimensions and the designated colors at the extreme columns. My logic centers around a midpoint calculation, where columns closer to color 2 are assigned that color at a negative offset, moving leftward from the defined boundaries. I'm exploring the implications of assigning the other boundary to the opposite side of the grid.


**Verifying Color Distribution**

I've been meticulously checking the color distribution logic by hand, row by row, confirming it accurately places colors based on proximity to the defined boundaries. It looks like I am on the right track; the logic does, at first glance, appear sound. I am verifying the results of edge cases as well to make sure I haven't missed any. I have added several more edge cases to verify the calculations.
